description: Land Acquisition - Koswatta, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned.
